input.summary: Make the §2 licence perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide and royalty-free with rights to use, modify and sublicense the Software (including Improvements and Modifications) and Documentation, conform §17(a) so that licence survives termination, conform the §3(c) sublicence bar, and limit Garman's use of our data to providing the services.
input.comment: [Playbook] Garman keeps ownership of the Work, but our licence must be perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free and extend to modifying and sublicensing the Software (including Improvements and Modifications) and Documentation for our business, so we have removed the Authorized-Locations place-of-use cap and additional-fee sentence, carved the Section 2 licence out of the Section 17(a) termination mechanic so perpetuity is not contradicted, and deleted the conflicting sublicence bar in Section 3(c). We have also confirmed that any licence to Garman in our data is limited to processing it solely to provide the services.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation. Sparkling's right, if any, to use the Software and Documentation at locations other than the Authorized Locations is subject to the payment of additional fees in accordance with the Fee Schedule.
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling, a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use, modify and sublicense for Sparkling's business purposes: (i) the Software, including any Improvements and Modifications, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400; and (ii) the Documentation.

ops.oldText: This Agreement and the license granted under this Agreement shall remain in effect perpetually as long as fees are paid by Sparkling in accordance with the Fee Schedule and the Agreement is not otherwise terminated in accordance with this Section.
ops.newText: This Agreement shall remain in effect perpetually as long as fees are paid by Sparkling in accordance with the Fee Schedule and the Agreement is not otherwise terminated in accordance with this Section. The licence granted under Section 2 survives expiry or termination of this Agreement.

ops.oldText: not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person
ops.newText: not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease or export the Work to any Person

ops.text: Any licence granted to Garman in Sparkling's data is limited to processing that data solely to provide the services under this Agreement.
